display_long_description:
A sport with 2.5 billion fans worldwide is now in VR as iB Cricket (vSport). Walk into world-class stadiums, hear fans roar, and smash the ball out of the park🔥With realistic physics, you can learn and start playing in just 10 minutes, no prior experience needed!🏏

Loved by players from **40+ countries**, including both cricketing and non-cricketing nations. The game has seen over **1 billion balls** played and earned appreciation from **100+ world-class cricketers**🏏🔥


# **Explore the World of iB Cricket**

**🏟️20+ Stadiums**: Feel the electric atmosphere as you make your debut on legendary grounds packed with cheering fans 🎉

**📖Campaign Mode**: Start in the backyard and rise to global stardom 🌟 Unlock new stadiums and craft your legendary journey

**🤝PvP Mode**: Challenge friends, set smart field placements, bowl tactically, and dominate your opponents 💪

**🌍CO-OP Mode**: Team up with a friend from anywhere in the world. Banter, bond, and chase targets together 🤜🤛

**🏏Net Practice**: Train like a pro! Customize pace, swing, spin, line & length to master every shot 🧠

**⏱️Multiple Formats**: 20, 50 overs & unlimited overs

**🏆Leagues & Tournaments**: Feel the pressure, chase glory

**🤖AI Coaching**: Improve technique with smart coaching

**⚾Numerous Bowling Options**: Right-arm & left-arm bowlers featuring fast, medium pace, off-spin, leg-spin, and more.

**🧠Intelligent AI Fielding**: Realistic, dynamic gameplay

**🎯VR Bowling**: Bowl short, good length or full and top the leaderboards

**🏠 Fun MR Games**: Bring cricket into your real world
